units.title: Introduction to Operational Amplifiers
topics: 1.1. Classification of IC: based on type, Temperature, Type of user, No of integrated components
1.2. IC packages, pin identification
1.3. Operational amplifier: definition, block diagram, Pin Outs (TO-5, 8-DIP,14-DIP), Circuit symbol
1.4. Operational Amplifier Parameters: Input offset voltage and current, Input Linear Electronic Circuits Course Code: 4332403 above level) Topics and Sub-topics

uos: 1.a. Classify IC based on their type, Temperature, User, No of Component.
1.b. Identify various types of ICs and packages.
1.c. Give Advantages of ICs over Discrete components.

1.f. List ideal characteristics of Op-Amp. bias current, Input capacitance, Input voltage range, Common mode rejection ratio, Output voltage swing, output resistance, Power consumption, slew rate, Thermal Drift, Power Supply rejection ratio, Noise.
